title: 翻找
text:
脚下这片还没人翻过。每个搜索点能搜几次，翻得越久，越可能惊动附近的东西。这里很安静，放心搜。

按{ui:搜索}翻一次：搜到的东西会一件一件亮出来，直接拖进包里就行；拖到棋盘外的都算{zone:地上}，{zone:地上}是这个点上的临时地方：走了东西留在这个点，回来能拿。关掉搜索界面会回到这里，再决定搜不搜。

texts.en:
Nobody has picked through this patch yet. Each search spot can be searched a few times, and the longer you dig, the likelier you are to wake something nearby. It's quiet here. Search freely.

Press {ui:搜索} to search once. Finds turn up one at a time; drag them straight into your bag. Anything dragged off the board goes to the {zone:地上}. The {zone:地上} is a holding place at this spot: leave, and the items stay here for you to come back to. Close the search window to come back here and decide whether to search again.
